status: Teaching cases; assumptions are transparent, uncalibrated and not strategy validation

cases.classification: Illustrative guidance-run-rate scenario, not a complete historically estimated investment forecast
cases.thesis: Annualize the announced next-quarter revenue midpoint as a transparent starting run rate, then fade toward maturity. Do not assume that management guided the entire fiscal year or the next decade.

rules.firstYearGrowth: 4 * Q1 guidance revenue / last full fiscal year revenue - 1
rules.targetMargin: 30% common illustrative mature margin across all dates; sensitivity 20%-40%
rules.tax: 25% illustrative mature cash-tax assumption, not management near-term effective tax guidance
rules.wacc: 10% common illustrative nominal USD hurdle; sensitivity 8%-14%; NOT a reconstructed historical WACC
rules.terminalROIC: 10%, competitive steady state equal to illustrative WACC

uncertainty: Annualizing one quarter ignores seasonality, demand acceleration/deceleration and later quarters.
The linear fade engine does not implement quarter-specific margin guidance or a segmented cycle/hypergrowth model.
Historical risk-free/ERP/beta/spread vintages are not yet reconstructed; discount rates are scenarios.
Capital intensity and mature margin are common teaching assumptions, not facts established by these filings.
Forecasts are retrospectively reconstructed; model/human hindsight cannot be eliminated.
